programme.title: El Fenómeno
programme.desc: El Fenómeno era el niño prodigio que lo tenía todo. Campeón del Mundo a los 17 años. Mejor jugador del año a los 20. Dos veces récord mundial de un traspaso a los 21. Impresionantes goles allá donde jugó. Y entonces, todo le fue brutalmente arrebatado.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Portugal - Uzbekistán
programme.desc: El Mundial más grande de la historia ya está aquí. La gran cita de selecciones de la FIFA cuenta por primera vez con 48 equipos en busca de la gloria. Estados Unidos, México y Canadá se convierten en el epicentro del planeta fútbol del 11 de junio al 19 de julio.

programme.title: Buenos días América
programme.desc: Durante el Mundial, este espacio toma el pulso a todo lo acontecido en Norteamérica en la gran cita de Selecciones del año. Las mejores imágenes de los partidos y el análisis para empezar el día informado de lo que ha acontecido durante la madrugada.

programme.title: Stories From The Cities
programme.desc: Un espacio que recorre las ciudades sede de Estados Unidos, México y Canadá. En lugar de enfocarse únicamente en los estadios, el show explora la cultura local, la gastronomía, la música, la gente y el arraigo del fútbol base (fútbol comunitario) en cada una de ellas.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Inglaterra - Ghana

Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as Abi from Bradford, Greg from Southend-on-Sea, Gaynor from Coalville and Scott from London pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: STV News at Six and Weather
programme.desc: Including regional weather forecast.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Norway v France
programme.desc: Norway v France (Kick-off 8.00pm). All the action from the final match in Group I for both teams, held at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the first meeting between the nations since 2014, when France prevailed 4-0 in a friendly. The French are likely to go into this fixture as favourites to win once again, but a closer contest is anticipated. Should they both be available, the game could see two of the world's leading forwards go head to head in Frenchman Kylian Mbappe and Norway's Erling Haaland, and it would be little surprise if either one of them proved to be the difference-maker this evening.

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals

programme.title: Night Vision

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: The celebrated chef arrives in the south-eastern town of Annecy, where he wanders around its market to select ingredients for his first cook. On the stunning shore of its crystal clear lake, James cooks dishes showcasing delicious local tomatoes, red mullet and lobster. He then visits award-winning pastry chef Philippe Rigollot to sample some of his extraordinary creations.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: In Bilbao, James visits a huge indoor food market, takes a funicular to a famous steak restaurant, and sees how La Carolina is made. Later, he heads to a winery on a seabed, before cooking up dishes including squid ink arancini and Basque cheesecake.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team reveal how adding water can transform any size garden, creating two incredible water gardens, one outside and one inside. In Kent, Alan, Frances Tophill and David Domoney build a stunning outdoor space in a small plot featuring three different but equally spectacular water features. Meanwhile, Katie Rushworth reveals how to build an indoor water feature that can transform a bare corner of a home.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: Ainsley Harriott celebrates brunch, serving up an Indian-inspired French toast and plant-based breakfast tacos. He also welcomes Emmett J Scanlon and Jessica Sweetman into the kitchen, and goes on a cheesy adventure in Malta.

programme.title: ITV News

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James welcomes actor Nigel Havers to his home in the Hampshire countryside and tastes delicious recipes from chefs Tom Aikens, Sabrina Gidda and Atul Kochhar.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary visits Sligo, heading out into the bay with Glen and Aisling of Sligo Oysters to get his hands dirty on a working oyster farm before cooking the catch. In Sligo town, chef Anthony Gray leads him through treasured food institutions Clarke's, a family butcher, and Cosgrove \u0026 Sons, a provisions store, and then cooks up a proudly Irish surf and turf.

programme.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
programme.desc: James is joined by chef Galton Blackiston for a tour of Cornwall. They sample some world-class ice cream before visiting Newlyn fish market to buy cod, which James cooks with oysters and tartare sauce. The trip concludes with a visit to Sennen beach, where they practice their oil painting and break out the barbecue.

programme.title: Downton Abbey

Director Michael Engler's drama based on the TV series, starring Hugh Bonneville, Michelle Dockery and Maggie Smith.

programme.title: Spaceballs
programme.desc: In a distant galaxy, planet Spaceball has depleted its air supply, leaving its citizens reliant on a product called "Perri-Air." In desperation, Spaceball's leader President Skroob (Mel Brooks) orders the evil Dark Helmet (Rick Moranis) to kidnap Princess Vespa (Daphne Zuniga) of oxygen-rich Druidia and hold her hostage in exchange for air. But help arrives for the Princess in the form of renegade space pilot Lone Starr (Bill Pullman) and his half-man, half-dog partner, Barf (John Candy).

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including 20 Emmys and three Peabody Awards.
